sloka: कुर्यात्तदुनुरागेण तमहुः पुरुषोत्तमम् ।यो नियुक्तः परम् कार्यम् न कुर्यान्नऋपतेः प्रियम् ॥६-१-८॥।।
transliteration: kuryāttadunurāgeṇa tamahuḥ puruṣottamam ।yo niyuktaḥ param kāryam na kuryānnaṛpateḥ priyam ॥6-1-8॥।।

translations.english: An efficient servant does not only do what is asked but also does the work dear to the king. One who does not do so is said to be mediocre.
